# 关键业务动作反馈
覆盖 `select_character`、`send_message`、`recharge_create_order`、`vip_create_order`、`daily_checkin`、`support_send_message`、`image_generate`、`voice_generate`、`create_conversation`。动作开始时冻结白名单 route 与 canonical entry；不采集 URL、ID、按钮文案或全局 DOM click。主指标是前台有效等待到反馈，目标 ≤2000ms；stall/discarded 必须与成功 N 同看。旧 release 的硬编码 `/chat/:id` 不能与新 release 混算。

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_action" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_roleplay_action" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_source_measurement_version="action_foreground_v1" | context_outcome="feedback" | context_entry=~"$entry" | context_route=~"$route" | context_action=~"$action" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (context_entry, context_route, context_action, context_tg_platform)

panels.description: 只计算有 feedback duration 的动作；stall/discarded 不填 0，见终态面板。

targets.expr: sum by (context_entry, context_route, context_action, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_action" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_roleplay_action" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_source_measurement_version="action_foreground_v1" | context_outcome="feedback" | context_entry=~"$entry" | context_route=~"$route" | context_action=~"$action" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | duration_ms <= 2000 [$__range])) / sum by (context_entry, context_route, context_action, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_action" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_roleplay_action" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_source_measurement_version="action_foreground_v1" | context_outcome="feedback" | context_entry=~"$entry" | context_route=~"$route" | context_action=~"$action" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" [$__range]))

panels.title: 2秒内反馈占比

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_action" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_roleplay_action" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_source_measurement_version="action_foreground_v1" | context_outcome="feedback" | context_entry=~"$entry" | context_route=~"$route" | context_action=~"$action" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_entry, context_route, context_action, context_tg_platform)

panels.title: 反馈 P95 趋势（2秒阈值）

panels.description: 每 entry/route/action/platform N<100 时延长窗口。

targets.expr: sum by (context_entry, context_route, context_action, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_action" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_roleplay_action" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_source_measurement_version="action_foreground_v1" | context_outcome="feedback" | context_entry=~"$entry" | context_route=~"$route" | context_action=~"$action" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" [$__range]))

panels.title: 成功反馈样本量 N

panels.description: waiting 是发起量；feedback、stalled、discarded 不是互斥 cohort（stalled 可迟到 feedback），用于构成排障而非直接相减。

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_entry, event_data_route, event_data_action, event_data_tg_platform, event_data_outcome) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_action" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_roleplay_action" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | event_data_source_measurement_version="action_foreground_v1" | event_data_entry=~"$entry" | event_data_route=~"$route" | event_data_action=~"$action" | event_data_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" [$__auto]))
